theorem: For every complex theta=(v0,v1,v2,lambda) with max_j|theta_j-1/4|<=2^-158, and every 9x9 Hermitian coefficient matrix C whose 81 real Hermitian coordinates differ from diag(1,1,3,1,3,3,3,3,3) by at most 2^-32, the explicitly defined 4x4 operator R(theta,C) is positive, entangled and has Schmidt number exactly 2 after normalization. If in addition its actual partial transpose is PSD, it is an entangled 4x4 PPT/SN2 state. The PPT condition is NOT claimed automatic for arbitrary off-diagonal C.
definitions: Use Eq.11 source coefficient matrices M_a,M_b,M_c,M_d,M_e,M_f,M_g,M_i,M_h and the local map K_theta from frontier-20261028-grid-generic-explicit-radius-v1.json SHA256 7603a59e72f5e2bde333262c50482697bc62ae20272a496048b02285529e4f53. Let m_j(theta)=vec(M_j K_theta^T), and R(theta,C)=sum_(j,k) C_jk |m_j(theta)><m_k(theta)|. The 81 real coordinates are the nine real diagonal entries and real/imaginary parts of upper off-diagonal entries, in the order used by the certificate. No diagonal-only or positive-C premise is required: positivity is obtained from the decomposition below.
weights_proof: The referenced explicit-radius proof gives continuously varying normalized complex-SR<=2 atoms with real 81x761 Gram matrix A(theta), positive normalized base weights w0_j>2^-18, sum_j w0_j=21, and an 81-column B(theta) with ||B(theta)^-1||_infinity<2^12 throughout the theta ball. It also proves every entry of A(theta)-A(theta0) is less than L*2^-158 with L<2^121. Keep the 680 nonselected base weights fixed and solve the 81 selected weights for the new coefficient coordinates d(C). Then B(theta)(w_B-w_B0)=d(C)-d(D)-(A(theta)-A(theta0))w0. The first term has infinity norm <=2^-32, and the second is <21*2^121*2^-158<2^-32. Thus ||w_B-w_B0||_infinity<2^12*2^-31=2^-19, strictly smaller than every selected base weight. All weights remain positive and their Gram sum equals C exactly, so R(theta,C) is a nonzero PSD sum of complex-SR<=2 projectors.
entanglement_proof: Project Alice and Bob onto output labels 0,1,2. The core range lies in M=[[a,b,c],[d,a,b],[e+v0*f,-d+v1*f,a+v2*f]], with unique coefficients near theta0 since v1 remains nonzero. Rank-one minors give 2a^2=-(a*v2-b*v1)f. For any separable decomposition, 4*C_aa^2 <= S*C_ff where S=|v2|^2 C_aa+|v1|^2 C_bb-2Re(v2 conjugate(v1) C_ab). On the prescribed bounds, |v1|,|v2|<=5/16, C_aa,C_bb<=17/16, C_aa>=15/16, |C_ab|<=1/8, and C_ff<4. Therefore S<1/4, so S*C_ff<1 while 4*C_aa^2>1: contradiction. The core and parent are entangled; the positive SR<=2 decomposition makes the Schmidt number exactly2. The strict inequality and all moments are homogeneous, so normalization does not change the conclusion.
explicit_ppt_subfamily: The extra PPT hypothesis is nonvacuous. For any theta in the theta ball, any phase |z|=1, and 0<=t<=2^-34, let xi have source coefficients G=1,I=z and all others0; set C=(1-t)D+t xi xi^*. Its coordinate difference from D is at most 3t<2^-32. Its physical operator is (1-t)R(theta,D)+t[|3,0>+z|3,2>], a sum of a PPT projection of R and a product projector, hence PPT. Nonzero off-diagonal C_GI values occur for t>0, and the theorem proves all these states entangled/SN2.

limits: The coefficient and projection balls are conservative, and R(theta,C) is restricted to the nine-dimensional projected source support. This is not an open subset of the full 4x4 state space, does not make PPT automatic for arbitrary C, does not prove an all-state Schmidt-number bound, and supplies no 4x4 SN>=3 witness. No independent human/formal review or novelty clearance is claimed.
